verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Playing back samples only one time (One-shot Playback)
SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Pausing the sound of a sample (PAUSE)
SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Shortcuts that use the [SHIFT] button

text.ru: Удерживая [VALUE], нажми [GATE]: пэд играет сэмпл один раз целиком.
text.en: Hold [VALUE] and press [GATE]: the pad plays the sample once, fully.
To stop sounding samples: [SHIFT] + [EXIT]; pause with [SHIFT] + [HOLD].

tryIt.ru: Сделай one-shot на длинном риз-ударе и сыграй им фразу.
tryIt.en: Set one-shot on a long riser hit and play a phrase with it.
